motion_rule: a wild animal grazes on subscriptions and never learns who is charging him. He stands in one spot; paper drives across frame instead. Shot size changes every beat as in c
character: a shaggy musk ox, heavy skirt of hair swinging late behind him, slow single blinks, jaw grinding sideways
second_characters: ONE lemming, calm and clerical, planting a card every time he blinks; at the end it walks onto his nose at the lens
props: ONE gold card in the corner of his mouth from 1.80; A DRIFT of cards and receipt tape blowing across frame
prop_continuity: cards only ever increase on him; he swallows the gold card at 8.20
environment: open sunlit tundra at noon, blinding flat snow to the horizon
light_events: blinding noon off the snow, hard white bounce under his jaw

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: deep chesty male voice, calm and well fed, no complaint, biting each word, 3.6 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: pod-PEE-sok, TSE-ly, sug-ROP, ZNA-yu, da-YUT, pla-CHU — stress CHU, he pays, not weeping
audio.pacing: 1.80-4.60, 5.70-7.30 and 7.30-8.20 each one breath; after 8.20 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: his jaw drops wide and shapes every syllable around the card, never a voice over
audio.sfx: wind, crust breaking, plastic crunching, a swallow, three taps

timeline.a: his hoof punches through the crust, throwing a fan of snow and paper; only the leg works
his muzzle goes into the hole to the eyes and ploughs sideways, exactly like an ox after lichen
he pulls his muzzle out with a fan of cards in his lips; behind his ear a lemming is already busy
he chews, jaw circling, plastic cracking, one gold card left sticking out of his mouth
receipts skid past his hooves as his heavy skirt of hair swings after him, late
he punches the crust again out of habit, not meaning to eat
the crust gives, his leg drops to the knee and he hauls it out, the mountain rocking
he swallows, the lump going down his throat, while cards blow past him
he blinks once, slowly; the lemming plants a card in his fur and his ear twitches after
he swings his muzzle sideways, receipt tape frozen in his beard unrolling two metres
the gold card travels to the other corner of his mouth while he chews
he keeps chewing without a trace of complaint
he blinks again and the lemming plants a second card, patting it flat
he swallows the gold card, his throat working it down
he twists his muzzle to his shoulder and tears one card out of his fur with his teeth
he spits it away on the wind and lifts his head, chest out
the lemming walks down onto the bridge of his nose, huge at the lens, and plants three cards in a row, tap, tap, tap; he does not turn

must_appear: what he digs out is cards and receipts, not lichen; he swallows them; the lemming is on him from 1.15 and plants a card on every blink; at 9.35 it fills the lens on his nose and plants three
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, dark scene, a suffering animal, blood, injury, a parked camera, a background that never moves, a walking hero, a closed muzzle while speaking, a hoof over his mouth, slow motion, a camera pulling back, a foreign accent, a word not in the lines, cyrillic letters, words
